messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — around 08:14 UTC we started seeing a spike of 5xx and elevated 200+ms tail latencies for Dedicated customers in eu-west-1. Not a full outage but customers reported timeouts and we got multiple pages. Paging oncall now.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High error rate on routing-service -> eu-west-1 (alerts: routing.5xx_rate > 2% for 5m). Severity P2. Page sent to #eng-oncall.

Priya Nair: I'm on it, grabbing logs. Initial look: routing-service instances are returning 503s from the model-proxy layer when kv-cache misses happen concurrently with model loading. Appears correlated with a deployment of model-variant autoscaler yesterday.

Jonah Park: I can help with rollback/scale. Any customer impact list?

Support Team: Several premium Dedicated customers reported elevated errors in their dashboards between 08:12–08:20 UTC. No full customer-facing downtime reported yet but 2 rate-limited jobs failed. Sending list in DM.

Priya Nair: Mitigation steps I'm doing now: 1) pause autoscaler for the affected pool, 2) scale pool up by +3 nodes, 3) enable model-fallback policy to the quantized-v1 model for EU region to reduce model load.

Marta Ruiz: If kv-cache regen is the culprit we should avoid global cache flush. Do a rolling warming instead. I have a small script to pre-warm prefixes for known heavy routes.

ops-bot: Command executed by Priya Nair: `k8s scale deployment routing-service-eu --replicas=12 --namespace=dedicated-eu`

Alex Chen: Good. Priya — can you confirm whether the 503s drop after scale + fallback? Also add a short note to runbook about avoiding simultaneous autoscaler + cache purge.

Priya Nair: Update @channel — after scaling + enabling fallback the 5xx rate dropped to 0.6% in the last 3m and tail latencies are trending toward normal. No new pages in last 6 min. Moving to monitoring.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident status changed to MONITORING by Priya Nair.

Jonah Park: Action items I suggest before handoff: 1) add guardrail to autoscaler to prevent >30% concurrent model reloads, 2) add alert for high kv-cache-regens/sec, 3) schedule a canary test for the autoscaler change in staging. I'll open a ticket.

Marta Ruiz: Running pre-warm now — script output below:
```
prewarm --prefixes=/users/top,/routes/chat --target=3
[ok] warmed 2 prefixes on 4 nodes
[ok] background warm jobs queued
```

Alex Chen: Nice. Also: link to runbook we followed: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/routing-service-cache-regen. Please add exact commands we ran.

Priya Nair: Creating Jira: RW-4123 "routing: autoscaler + cache regen -> elevated 5xx in eu-west-1". Assigning to eng-runtime. Includes rollback playbook, fallback toggles, and postmortem checklist.

Jonah Park: For tonight's handoff — coverage note: Marta is OOO after 22:00 UTC, APAC overlap is thin. I can take primary for the 22:00–06:00 UTC window if needed, Priya can stay primary until 22:00.

Priya Nair: I will be primary until 22:00 UTC, then hand to Jonah. Secondary will be Alex Chen until 02:00, then Support Team as backup.

Alex Chen: Confirmed. Quick runbook pointers in the thread: 1) rollback autoscaler: `kubectl patch deployment autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"replicas":1}}'` 2) enable fallback in config: `redwoodctl feature set fallback.quantized-v1 true --scope=eu` 3) monitor query: `sum(rate(routing_5xx_total[5m])) / sum(rate(routing_request_total[5m]))`

Marta Ruiz: Follow-ups for tomorrow: add a section in runbook about progressive cache warming (avoid global flush), and add a play for scheduled canary of autoscaler. I'll draft the changes.

Support Team: Customer comms: sent soft notification to affected Dedicated customers at 08:40 UTC — said we're investigating and applying mitigations. No escalations yet.

incident-bot: New annotation: Mitigation applied: scale up + fallback toggle. Pages suppressed for 15m.

Priya Nair: Current status for handoff note: Incident resolved -> monitoring. 5xx and latency normal. Jira RW-4123 created. Runbook link updated with initial commands. Primary through 22:00 UTC: Priya Nair. Primary 22:00–06:00 UTC: Jonah Park. Secondary through 02:00 UTC: Alex Chen; Secondary 02:00–10:00 UTC: Support Team. Coverage gap: APAC late-night is single-oncall; reach out if any pagers.

Alex Chen: Next steps (short): 1) Jonah to add autoscaler guardrail + staging canary (RW-4123 subtasks). 2) Marta to update runbook with progressive pre-warm guidance. 3) Priya to add alert for kv-cache-regens/sec and increase retention of request logs for eu-west-1 by 24h. 4) Support to follow up with any customers if errors reoccur.

Jonah Park: Taking notes, will create subtasks and ping when canary scheduled.

Marta Ruiz: I'll own the runbook update and link back to RW-4123 once done.

Priya Nair: No active pages at the moment. Handing off. If anything spikes, page me and Jonah.

Alex Chen: Thanks all. Handoff acked. :thumbsup:
